result:
Ten services call ts-station-service directly. Each one hard-codes the `http://ts-station-service:12345/...` URL in its main (non-test) Java code. I found them by grepping the checkout, not the NextTrace graph. Test files also contain these URLs, but I left them out.

I did not count `ts-ui-dashboard`. Its `nginx.conf` mentions ts-station-service, but that is a front-end proxy and not a `ts-*-service` caller.

For `ts-admin-basic-info-service`, line 27 only defines the URL as a string field. Other lines in that file build on it to make the call, and I didn't read them.
